answer: An applicant with a orchard but no relic is a pretender; with a relic but no walnut is a gambler; with neither is a tale the panel has heard before. The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Vault mosaicist tessellated medallion proof laid upon the atrium: the toll is each tessellated medallion is a season of logged tessera tests plus a signed marble, paid in the open. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 33 minutes per proof, 25674 minutes for 778, due every single epoch.
